title: Keep every PAM service disabled at package installation — mandatory failure
summary: When a mandatory setup piece is missing (model, sysuser, systemd unit, D-Bus service, or PAM module), the install hook's validation function returns nonzero. This is asserted by the test suite for each missing piece individually. The install hooks print a FATAL line per missing piece to stderr before exiting nonzero.

models_missing.given: fake root with all mandatory pieces except /var/lib/namtor/models

sysusers_missing.given: fake root with all mandatory pieces except /usr/lib/sysusers.d/namtor.conf

socket_unit_missing.given: fake root with all mandatory pieces except namtor-daemon.socket

dbus_service_missing.given: fake root with all mandatory pieces except org.namtor.Manager.service

pam_module_missing.given: fake root with all mandatory pieces except pam_namtor.so

fail_closed_contract: All three distro hooks (Arch post_install, Fedora %post, Debian postinst configure) call namtor_validate after activating the socket. If validation fails, the hook prints 'mandatory setup incomplete' to stderr and returns/exits nonzero. No success message is printed when validation fails.
